hints.title: Modulo Three Bit Accumulation State
hints.text: Every element appears three times except one. What modulo three counter state machine can track bit occurrences across all numbers in constant space?

hints.title: Dual State Mask Transition Invariant
hints.text: Two bit variables ones and twos track bits seen once or twice modulo 3; when a bit appears a third time, both reset to 0.

hints.title: Bitwise State Machine Update Procedure
hints.text: For each integer, update ones by bitwise xor with the current number and bitwise and with not twos. Update twos by bitwise xor with current number and bitwise and with not ones. Return ones.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input array length or bit count
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using a hash set or counting table requires O(N) auxiliary space, violating the strict O(1) space requirement.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating a 2-bit counter using ones and twos state masks runs in O(N) time with O(1) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should derive the digital logic truth table or explain bitwise modulo-3 counting.
